Container.Name: hub-warmer
Container.Overview: Keeps the rows on Plex's Home screen and library pages cached for every account and client. Requires Plex debug logging to be enabled. After starting, open the WebUI, enter the Plex address and sign in with the account that owns the Plex server. All settings are in the WebUI.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone of the Plex server
